Now O at cols 49-53, b still under at same cols. So b follows O. Likely O and b are a combined piece that moves horizontally but cannot go down. Maybe need to push b aside via something else? Maybe need to align with something else like G region? The O now near right edge of G region? The G region ends maybe at col ~? Hard. sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# move right repeatedly until no change in O position
prev_cols=None
steps=0
while steps<10:
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    O=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='O'][0]
    cols=sorted(p[1] for p in O['boundary'])
    if cols==prev_cols:
        break
    prev_cols=cols
    action(['RIGHT'], intent='solve')
    steps+=1
    print('step',steps,'cols',cols)
print('final cols',cols)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
